BiblicalUsage: The word rôb means abundance (in any respect). It stands in 1 Chronicles 4:38, "These mentioned by names princes in their families…", and in 1 Kings 1:19, "…hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put rôb here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
